name: Bhargava Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, where Bhargava Rama performed penance.

name: Yogananda Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, where the Lord taught Prahlada yogic postures.

name: Chatravata Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, installed under a peepal tree.

name: Ahobila Narasimha Swamy
significance: The earliest cave temple of Ugra Narasimha across the hills.

name: Krodakara / Varaha Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, featuring the deity with the face of a boar alongside Lakshmi.

name: Karanja Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, installed under a Karanja tree.

name: Malola Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, featuring the graceful form of Lord Narasimha with Lakshmi.

name: Jwala Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, marking the actual spot of Hiranyakasipu's slaying.

name: Pavana Narasimha Swamy
significance: One of the nine shrines, situated on the banks of the Pavana river.

name: Prahlada Varada Sannidhi
significance: The central temple complex at Lower Ahobilam, dedicated to Prahlada Varada, containing shrines for Lakshmi, Andal, and the Azhwars.

name: Ugra Sthambham
significance: Mountain cleft shrine. Trekkers climb ~8 km from Upper Ahobilam; guide recommended.

name: Prahlada Mettu
significance: Cave shrine located between Upper Ahobilam and Ugra Sthambham.
